thread:
maya (Design): starting the thread — proposing a compact sidebar regroup for the console to reduce deep-link confusion. current pain: people open /models then try to find routing options and end up in Settings.
kevin (Frontend): can you sketch the groups? is this more tabs or move items to a subnav? :thinking:
sophie (Product): high-level goal: make common paths 1 click from top-level (Models, Deployments, Monitor, Billing). less cognitive load for new users.
maya (Design): rough grouping idea: - Core: Models, Datasets - Deploy: Deployments, Jobs - Observe: Monitor, Logs, Alerts - Admin: Billing, Settings, Team
kevin (Frontend): I like grouping. concern: deep links like /models/:id/versions should still open the Models section and set breadcrumb correctly. current router relies on path prefixes.
alex (Eng): important note: we have legacy links from docs and partner integrations that expect /console/models/.. can't break them. We should maintain backwards-compatible redirects.
maya (Design): agreed, plan: authoritative nav sections + router alias table that maps old prefixes to new groups and sets aria-current. e.g. when hitting /models/123 -> highlight Core > Models and breadcrumbs: Console / Models / Model 123
sophie (Product): also need to track navigation analytics so we can see dropped flows. add an event on section open + deep link landing.
kevin (Frontend): quick draft for redirect rules we can add to the router (pseudo):
```
{ from: '/console/model/:id*', to: '/console/core/models/:id*', notifyBreadcrumb: true }
{ from: '/console/deploy/:env*/logs', to: '/console/observe/logs/:env*' }
```
kevin (Frontend): technically we'll implement as router middleware, not a 302 — keep client-side history tidy.
maya (Design): accessibility nit: when redirecting into a new grouping, ensure focus lands on the section title and set role=\"main\" skip link. screen reader should announce new section. add aria-current on the nav item.
alex (Eng): noted. also watch for route transition animations — they can trap focus. opt for short fade + focus restore.
sophie (Product): UX copy tweak: in breadcrumbs prefer 'Console' -> 'Models' -> 'Model 123' rather than 'Console > Core > Models > Model 123'. users don't care about the group name.
maya (Design): agree, show group in sidebar visually (small caps) but hide from breadcrumb. breadcrumb should be the content path.
kevin (Frontend): implementation question: do we prefer path-based grouping (/console/core/models) or meta state on route that maps to the sidebar? path-based is simpler for deep links but clutters URLs.
alex (Eng): we can keep short urls (/console/models/...) and set navGroup metadata in route config. that way deep links stay clean and sidebar determines group by route.meta.group. also set canonical route for share links.
maya (Design): for the A/B, propose test A: show group labels in sidebar with collapse state default open. Test B: compact sidebar where groups collapse into icons with hover labels. measure task completion for finding 'Routing' from /models.
sophie (Product): rollout plan: feature flag + canary to 10% orgs, collect navigation drop-off and support tickets for 2 weeks. if no regressions, ramp.
kevin (Frontend): TODOs from frontend: 1) update router middleware for aliases 2) add route.meta.group 3) keyboard nav tests 4) add analytics event.
alex (Eng): backend TODO: maintain redirect table for external links + update docs links. also add automated smoke test that loads old urls and asserts correct nav highlight.
maya (Design): small copy nits: sidebar group header text should be sentence case, icons need accessible labels, tooltip delay 300ms.
sophie (Product): one more constraint: Dedicated customers have extra top-level 'Capacity' item. group logic should allow customer-specific overrides.
kevin (Frontend): that will be a runtime config. good to know.
aria-bot: reminder: design-review meeting on Thu 10am to approve final IA. Agenda posted: https://redwood.internal/agenda/console-ia.
maya (Design): thanks! I'll update the Figma with route aliases and a11y notes before the meeting. please drop short comments there if you see issues. :thumbsup:
